def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    s=[0]+[x+1 for x in sr]; e=[x for x in sr]+[H-1]
    s2=[0]+[x+1 for x in sc]; e2=[x for x in sc]+[W-1]
    mk=next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in {g[sr[0]][0] if sr else None} and v not in {g[r][sc[0]] for r in range(H)} | {g[sr[0]][0] if sr else 0}) if sr and sc else 3
    # simpler: marker = most common non-separator color... derive: colors not in {sep color}
    sep={g[r][0] for r in sr}|{g[0][c] for c in sc}
    mk=[v for v in {v for row in g for v in row}-sep][0]
    return [[1 if sum(1 for r in range(a,b+1) for c in range(x,y+1) if g[r][c]==mk)==2 else 5 for x,y in zip(s2,e2)] for a,b in zip(s,e)]
for demo in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    r=transform(G[demo+' input'])
    print(demo, r==G[demo+' output'], r)
